nationalOverlay.grain: SEC IARD roster firm with principal-office region = TX
nationalOverlay.label: SEC/IARD roster firms with a Texas principal office
nationalOverlay.caveat: This is the national SEC/IARD roster overlay for firms that report a Texas principal office. It is not the Texas state-registered adviser universe, not a complete Texas adviser count, and not proof of current Texas State Securities Board authority. TX PRINCIPAL OFFICE != TEXAS STATE REGISTRATION.

riaEra.caveat: National roster keeps RIA (17,018) and ERA (6,604) separate. Committed geography is on the combined roster. Texas principal-office counts are not an RIA-only or ERA-only state denominator. ERA is not an RIA. SEC RIA is not a Texas state RIA.

firmMarket.note: National RIA RAUM bands and Form ADV attributes exist on the federal spine. This snapshot does not invent a Texas-only size ranking from those national tables.

stateRia.searchFields: Firm CRD/IARD number or TX file number
stateRia.caveat: No official Texas state-RIA bulk CSV/XLSX/API was acquired. Certificate search is official and search-only. Do not estimate the missing state roster from SEC principal-office geography. Do not scrape the search.

enforcement.identityBar: EXACT CRD, exact Texas file number, or exact order/docket-to-identity relationship
enforcement.caveat: SSB publishes a paginated HTML administrative-action index and PDF orders. That is not a structured bulk CSV/JSON extract and was not harvested page-by-page. Notice of hearing is not a final disposition. Accusation is not a final finding. Order count is not quality. Name-only attachment is unsafe. Missing is unknown, not zero.

issuer.framework: Texas Securities Act (Texas Government Code Title 12) administered by the Texas State Securities Board — securities registration, exemptions, notice filings, dealer/agent registration, and investment-adviser/IAR registration.
issuer.privateFundExemption: Board Rule §139.23 private-fund adviser exemption; ERA/Texas notice via Form ADV Item 2.C when applicable.
issuer.note: Federal Form D is not Texas qualification or approval. Notice filings and exemptions are not a quality ranking. No statewide issuer bulk denominator was acquired.

formD.caveat: FORM D FILING != TEXAS STATE APPROVAL. FORM D FILING != INVESTMENT QUALITY.

exam.note: Texas publishes qualification-exam rules (Series 65/66 and related waivers, including NASAA EVEP recognized March 13, 2025) and a current electronic rulebook. That is individual qualification guidance, not a public firm-level examination scorecard. Guidance is not enforcement and is not a quality score.

contacts.policy: Official/public business sources only. No internet enrichment. No SSB search scrape. No person contact publication.
contacts.federalPrincipalOfficeAddress: Used only as geography for the SEC/IARD overlay; not republished here as a harvested directory.

regulatorMatrix.regulator: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / IARD
regulatorMatrix.proves: Federal registration category as reported on Form ADV in the cited extract
regulatorMatrix.doesNotProve: Texas State Securities Board state-RIA registration or current Texas notice-filing status

regulatorMatrix.regulator: SEC / IARD (and Texas notice under Board Rule §139.23 when applicable)
regulatorMatrix.proves: ERA reporting status in the cited extract
regulatorMatrix.doesNotProve: SEC RIA registration or Texas state-RIA registration

regulatorMatrix.proves: Texas investment-adviser certificate when the official SSB record says so
regulatorMatrix.doesNotProve: SEC registration. Principal-office geography is not this credential.

regulatorMatrix.proves: Individual representative reporting when official CRD/SSB evidence exists
regulatorMatrix.doesNotProve: Firm certificate. Person CRD is not firm CRD.

regulatorMatrix.regulator: Texas State Securities Board / FINRA / CRD
regulatorMatrix.proves: Broker-dealer or agent registration when official evidence exists
A registration, exemption, or notice-filing posture when the official filing record says so
regulatorMatrix.doesNotProve: Investment quality or Form D approval

regulatorMatrix.proves: A stable identity key when source-native

identityRules.HIGH_CONFIDENCE: exact legal name + exact official address for non-adverse descriptive data only
identityRules.UNSAFE: name alone — not used for adverse attachment
